$description: Radii, stroke widths, dash patterns and card geometry, in output pixels.

reply.$description: A reply in a sequence (UML 2.5.1, 17.4.4.1); a sequence has no edge taken only sometimes, so the two never meet.

operand.$description: The line between two operands of a fragment (UML 2.5.1, 17.6.4.1).

fragment.$description: A sequence fragment's frame in the avatars look, and the lines between its operands there: a boundary of a stretch of time, as a frame's dash is a boundary.

arrowhead.$description: The open arrowhead at an edge's end: how far its legs reach back along the line, how wide it opens across it, and the gap its tip leaves before the card.

label.$description: An edge label's text: the widest it runs on one line before it wraps onto two.

pill-pad-x.$description: In a sequence, the room inside a pill (a message's label, a fragment's operator and guard) on either side of its words.

pill-pad-y.$description: In a sequence, the room inside a pill above and below its words.

legend.$description: A legend entry's swatch: its size, and the gap before its text.

logo-inline.$description: A logo leading a card's note line, as tall as the note's letters.

logo-inline-gap.$description: Between an inline logo and the text after it.

avatar.$description: A sequence participant's head in the avatars look.

size.$description: The circle's diameter: the icon (card.horizontal-icon) with room round it, as a vertical card's badge holds its icon.

label-gap.$description: Between the circle and the participant's name under it.

activation.$description: A bar on a sequence lifeline while its participant answers a call (UML 2.5.1, 17.2.4.4).

width.$description: The bar's width: a thin rectangle, as UML draws it.

offset.$description: How far right a bar drawn over another on the same lifeline is moved, so both show (UML 2.5.1, Figure 17.2).

pack.$description: Between parts of a diagram that share nothing: the largest part and the rows of the others below it.

legend.$description: Between the diagram and its legend below it.

legend-entry.$description: Between two entries of the legend in a row.

legend-row.$description: Between two rows of the legend.

message-row.$description: The step from one message of a sequence to the next, down the page: a label of two lines in its pill (2 × 12 × 1.2 + 2 × label.pill-pad-y = 38.8) and spacing.label-gap above and below it, rounded up.

band-pad.$description: In a sequence, the room between a participant's head and the sides and top of its band, and between its band's foot and what is drawn last.

band-gap.$description: The least room between two participants' bands in a sequence.

self-width.$description: How far a message to its own lifeline reaches out, one rounded bend each way.

fragment-padding.$description: In a sequence, the room between a fragment's frame and the bands it covers, and again for each fragment nested inside it.

fragment-tag.$description: The height of a sequence fragment's pill, which holds its operator and its first guard on its frame's top edge, and of each later guard's pill, as a frame's name is tall.

label-gap.$description: In a sequence, the room between a label or a guard and what is under it: its line, its number or its frame's edge.

fragment-tag-pad.$description: The room inside a sequence fragment's pill on either side of its words, as a label's pill.
